name: manual_20586d
claim: At Mac session start after a Win session, always read REVIEW_QUEUE.md FIRST — the Win session completes tasks that Mac thought were pending. Never repeat work the Win session already did.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-28: Win session had completed Hermes Phase 6+9, canary verification, and multiple memory entries before Mac session started. REVIEW_QUEUE.md was the ground truth. Mac session confirmed all tasks were done and proceeded directly to the next gate (cross-probe + T5 tagging) without re-doing Win work.
